emulator.input_mode: one A press per run, frames 5..13, capture at frame 180

0x04.outcome: first effective incoming hit is cancelled; later hits are truncated; defender remains at 10 HP; no coordinate change; token consumed

0x09.outcome: defender takes no incoming damage; source HP changes 80 to 72; token consumed; flow proceeds to facing selection

0x0A.outcome: reverse damage changes source HP 80 to 72 and the original incoming hit still defeats the 10 HP defender; token consumed; victory follows

static_cross_check.0x04_and_0x16: 0x08076C44 adjacency gate, no ordinary damage path
static_cross_check.0x09: 0x08076BA8 reverse source/target recursive resolver, no ordinary damage path
static_cross_check.0x0A: 0x08076B1E reverse source/target recursive resolver, then ordinary damage path
static_cross_check.0x19: 0x08076BCC adjacency gate and reverse source/target recursive resolver

excluded_runs: Runs that encountered an existing base.sav or nested heavy-lock refusal are invalid and are not used by these conclusions.
